posts.trend: Tech Hiring in India 2026: Entry-level job roles slip to 4.3%; data engineering share nearly doubles
posts.context: Tech professionals must constantly re-skill every eighteen months to stay employed.
posts.angle: You rebrand your bio every two years only to receive the exact same advice your parents gave in 2010.
slides: In 2021 you were an agile product strategist.

In 2023 you became a prompt engineer.
In 2025 you added cloud architect to your bio.
Today you are enrolling in a ₹45,000 data engineering bootcamp.
posts.caption: Every WhatsApp group has one cousin who resends coding bootcamp links at 11 PM.
posts.rank_verdict: Slide 2 stacks too many job titles in the exact same format before the killer landing line saves it.
